description: Search the TripWays catalog of bookable tours, day trips, and activities worldwide. Pass a natural-language query plus any filters you already know: destination, price range in USD, duration in hours, activity, theme, or cancellation policy. Returns ranked tours with bokun_id, title, from-price, duration, destinations, rating, cancellation policy, hero_image, the TripWays page (url), and checkout_url. For live dates, remaining seats, or a group total, use check_availability and get_price_quote.

activity.description: Activity facet, e.g. food, hiking, snorkeling.

destination.description: Place name (city, region, country, or well-known area/landmark). Resolved against TripWays destinations; a landmark that is not a destination is added to the search text.

query.description: Natural-language search, e.g. 'family food tour in Rome under $100'.

name: search_tours
title: Search tours
